risk_description: There is a risk that excessive or unnecessary privileged access could enable unauthorised changes to critical systems or data, resulting in data compromise, service disruption or regulatory impact.
impact_description: Unauthorised access or modification of critical systems and sensitive information
treatment_action: Review privileged accounts, remove unnecessary standing privileges and strengthen privileged access governance.

risk_title: Critical Vulnerabilities Not remeidation within SLA
risk_description: There is a risk that critical security vulnerabilities are not remediated within defined timelines, increasing the likelihood that threat actors could exploit vulnerable systems
impact_description: System compromise, data loss or service disruption
treatment_action: Strengthen remediation SLAs, escalation processes and vulnerability ownership

risk_description: There is a risk that insecure configuration of cloud resources could expose systems or sensitive information to unauthorised access.
impact_description: Data exposure, system compromise and regulatory consequences
treatment_action: Implement configuration baselines, automated cloud-security monitoring and remediation processes

risk_description: There is a risk that security weaknesses at critical third parties could result in compromise, disruption or unauthorised disclosure of Northstar information.
vulnerability: Inconsistent supplier security assessments and ongoing monitoring
impact_description: Data breach, operational disruption and regulatory consequences
treatment_action: Establish risk-based supplier assessments and periodic monitoring for critical suppliers.

risk_description: There is a risk that security weaknesses identified within the customer portal could be exploited to gain unauthorised access to customer information or application functionality
vulnerability: Application security weaknesses identified during penetration testing
impact_description: Customer data compromise, fraud, reputational damage and regulatory consequences
treatment_action: Remediate high-priority penetration-test findings and perform independent retesting.

risk_description: There is a risk that insufficient logging and monitoring of critical systems could prevent or delay detection and investigation of security incidents.
impact_description: Delayed incident detection, increased attacker dwell time and reduced investigation capability
treatment_action: Identify logging gaps and onboard priority security events into central monitoring

risk_description: There is a risk that critical business services may not be recoverable within required recovery objectives because disaster recovery arrangements have not been sufficiently tested.
threat: Major technology outage or disruptive event
impact_description: Extended service outage, financial loss and inability to meet customer obligations
treatment_action: Conduct end-to-end recovery exercises for critical business services and document remediation actions.

risk_description: There is a risk that employees could respond to sophisticated phishing attacks, resulting in credential theft and unauthorised access to corporate systems
impact_description: Account compromise, data loss, fraud or further compromise of corporate systems
treatment_action: Continue targeted phishing simulations, security awareness training and technical email-security improvements.

risk_title: Failure to meet regulatroy incident reporting requirements
risk_description: There is a risk that significant ICT or security incidents may not be identified, classified and reported to relevant regulatory authorities within required timeframes
vulnerability: Inadequate regulatory incident classification and escalation procedures
impact_description: Regulatory breach, enforcement action and reputational damage
treatment_action: Formalise regulatory incident classification, escalation, notification and testing procedures.

risk_description: There is a risk that user access may remain active after employment termination, enabling former personnel or compromised accounts to access company systems and information.
threat: Unathorised se if emoloyee credentials from a malicious actor
vulnerability: Delays or failures in the joiner-mover-leaver proces
impact_description: Unauthorised system access, information disclosure or fraudulent activity
treatment_action: Automate leaver notifications, establish access-removal SLAs and monitor completion of termination activities.
